title: Fourier coefficients of a junta witness
statement: Let $r$ be a nonnegative integer, let $g:\{\pm1\}^r\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$. Assume that $g$ depends only on coordinates in $J$. For every subset $T$ of the $|J|$ coordinates of the function obtained by restricting $g$ to $J$ with all coordinates outside $J$ fixed to $1$, its Fourier coefficient at $T$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $g$ at the corresponding subset of coordinates of $J$, using the increasing enumeration of $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a sign-valued function on the $r$-dimensional Boolean cube
$J$ is a subset of the $r$ coordinates
$T$ is a subset of the $|J|$ coordinates in the canonical enumeration of $J$
